choices_provenance: Agent-authored before any project-local candidate or research access, using general knowledge only.

ordered_choices.concept: A printmaker in an old riverside print workshop restrains a wind-lifted proof sheet while closing its drying-frame clamp; the newly secured edge is already flat and the remaining corner still lifts.
A seed courier at a canal-lock greenhouse transfers a wooden tray of labeled seed envelopes onto a narrow dry shelf while a rising lock-water reflection and wet gangway make haste visible.
A weather volunteer on a small observatory roof retrieves a loosened paper chart and secures it under a chartboard clip just before a gust pulls the last loose edge away.
A station poster installer at a hillside rail shelter slides a stiff route poster under a hinged frame bar while an incoming gust bows its still-free lower corner.

A lighthouse volunteer in a harbor lens-restoration room guides a fragile glass lens cassette into a padded wooden carrier; one corner is seated and the remaining suspended corner makes the care visible.
A pottery glaze technician beside a cooling kiln arranges warm test tiles on a numbered wire tray; the final tile sits on a handling pad while a fresh color-change strip marks a decision in progress.

A film projectionist in a tiny neighborhood cinema booth holds a curling film leader flat against a splicer while seating a metal clamp; the repaired section lies straight beside the still-curled tail.
A volunteer at a tide-map kiosk on a ferry pier lowers a slatted shutter to shield a wall map from windblown drizzle; the covered upper map is dry and the exposed lower map is spotted.

selected_choice.concept: A weather volunteer on a small observatory roof retrieves a loosened paper chart and secures it under a chartboard clip just before a gust pulls the last loose edge away.

requester_ownership_note: The selected fictional scene, garments, event mechanics, pose and photographic treatment are agent choices within open scope, not requester locks.
purpose: Preserve a hand-plotted weather record as a cold front approaches.
difficulty: A sudden gust lifts the sheet and curls its free corner.
current_action: One hand closes the board-mounted retaining bar at the top margin; the other pins the paper center.
visible_result: A straight captured upper margin contrasts with the still-curling free lower corner.

reference.scope: Visible face, short black bob and wispy bangs only; no identity, actual age or personality inferred.

predeclared_fashion_observations.expected: A substantial notched collar and matte brushed-wool fibers read as the outer garment.
A separate moss-green ribbed roll-neck lies inside the open coat lapels.
Narrow ribbed inner cuffs project beyond the wider coat sleeves.
Long pressed folds emerge below the shorter coat hem, with a small same-fabric fan opened by the gust.
Smooth dark leather, vamp creases and low stacked heels remain distinct from wool, knit and skirt folds.

predeclared_scene_observations: Both hands connect to their proper arms and separate chart targets.
The upper chart edge is held while a free lower corner curls.
A full-body view retains both boots and the coat-to-skirt layer relationship.
The directional weather cues and moving garments are consistent with the paper's gust.
